title: Qualify exported Math Discovery skill positive private-package consumer under default WSL Linux net11
commitMessage: test: qualify exported Discovery skill binaries on Linux net11

contribution.summary: Qualify the portable Discovery skill's actual exported package-only sample on Linux WSL net11 without requalifying or rewriting private packages.
contribution.value: Invoke the existing RS281 deterministic exporter into a fresh disposable directory and consume the exact four selected Math CLR operations on the default WSL Linux distribution under SDK 11.0.100. Verify twelve exported files, original runtime-only selection, three immutable private archive and DLL SHA-256 identities, exact locked net11 Composition/IR/Quantities NuGet closure, positive five-example output, and unchanged export/source archives. No broker installation, public publication, or native progress transition.
debtChanges: RS281 succeeded attempt 001 after three pre-attempt refusals (firstPassSucceeded=false); its exported positive package-only example is qualified on Windows .NET 11, not Linux.
Earlier RS261 Linux binary proof used a different Composition fixture and did not exercise the complete four-selected-operation portable skill export.
The source-generated skill and private package identities remain immutable; RS282 covers a distinct Linux boundary while M8/M9 stay planned/not-ready.
contribution.nextAction: After Linux source-free qualification, reconcile exact cross-platform export evidence and assess a forward-only M8 readiness path; leave external agent-host installation and broker authorization to their owners.
